AdultingOS Terms of Use

Version 2026-11-25 · Effective November 25, 2026

The service

AdultingOS helps you organize personal responsibilities: tasks, bills, document renewals, subscriptions and reminders, with general guides and an AI assistant. You must be 18 or older to use it.

Not a government service

AdultingOS is an independent lifestyle and personal organization application. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Philippine government or any government agency. Government-related information is provided for general guidance. Always verify requirements directly through official government sources.

AdultingOS does not process government applications, submit forms, execute bank transactions or payments, or provide regulated financial services.

No professional advice

Guides and Ask Adu provide general information only and are not legal, tax, medical or financial advice. AI-generated content may be incomplete or inaccurate. Check official sources and consult a qualified professional for decisions about your situation.

Your content

You own what you enter. You give us permission to store and process it only to provide the service. Do not enter full ID numbers, card details or passwords.

Amounts are yours

Financial figures are entered by you and are not verified balances. Reminders are a convenience; you remain responsible for meeting your obligations and deadlines.

Acceptable use

Do not misuse the service, attempt to access other users' data, overload or reverse-engineer it, or use Ask Adu to create harmful content.

Availability

We work to keep AdultingOS available, but features such as sync and Ask Adu may be interrupted. Your data stays usable on your device.

Ending your use

You can stop using AdultingOS and delete your account at any time in Settings. We may suspend accounts that break these terms.

Liability

To the extent permitted by Philippine law, AdultingOS is provided "as is" and we are not liable for indirect losses or for missed deadlines.
